name: Imperial Javelineers
headerMeta: Heroic era · Javelin/Melee infantry · skirmisher · 240 leadership · T4 mastery
pitch: Javelin infantry that throws before closing to melee, excelling at pressuring squishy targets and poking units during downtime. The 2026-06-25 patch buffed their Flying Shield with +13% damage and Knockback, shifting them from pure poke to area control.

doctrines.name: Health Doctrine
doctrines.note: or Breakthrough — Breakthrough is optional swap {2}

veterancy.label: Top line
veterancy.body: Double Shot for more raw javelin damage, but the two separate throws feel clunky compared to both landing together. {2}

veterancy.label: Bottom line
veterancy.body: Heal + extra ammo (five throws, six with Honor-tree node) — favors throw count over burst. {2}

battleRole.positioning: Position in the push targeting important units, especially heroes. {1} Shield throw + kite/run-away is Imperial Javs' unique strength to trade favorably into certain matchups. {1}
battleRole.formation: F3 (skirmish) formation before using the targeted throw ability (Marksman Target Throw) — if not facing the target, most throws will miss. {2}
battleRole.tips: Marksman Target Throw fails when the unit isn't facing the target; manipulate to F3 first. {2} Against a group, use the AoE throw first, then follow up with targeted throw for a rapid one-two. {2} Throwing from elevation extends range beyond the displayed red-zone (max range) marker — the higher the position, the farther the throw. {2}

controls.notes: Combo sequence: AoE throw first to tag a spread group, then targeted throw immediately after. {2} Ammo doctrine and bottom-line veterancy prioritize throw count. {2} Default (ability 1) throw in melee range targets the nearest enemy. {2}
